blocks.text: Bu derste gelecekten bahsetmeyi öğreniyorsun: «çaydanlığın kirecini temizleyeceğim», «lavabo taşacak», «yarın bakıcıyla buluşuyorum». Bunun için iki biçim var ve ikisini de zaten yarı yarıya biliyorsun.

examples.en: I am going to descale the kettle.
The sink is going to overflow.
I am meeting the carer tomorrow.

blocks.text: Bir şeyi yapmaya zaten karar verdiysen am / is / are going to + sözlükteki hâliyle eylem dersin: I am going to repaint the wall — «duvarı yeniden boyayacağım». Türkçede tek ek, İngilizcede dört parça: kim, bağlayıcı, going, to.

examples.en: I am going to descale the kettle.
She is going to repaint the wall.
We are going to alter the dress.
I am going to hang the bunting.

fixes.wrong: I going to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going to descaling the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

drill.why: going'den sonra her zaman to gelir.

blocks.text: Aynı biçim, işaretler gözünün önündeyken tahmin için de kullanılır: su kenara gelmiş — The sink is going to overflow; kule eğiliyor — The tower is going to topple.

examples.en: The sink is going to overflow.
The tower is going to topple.
The shelf is going to collapse.
The jumper is going to shrink.
The boards are going to rot.

fixes.right: The tower is going to topple.

fixes.wrong: The boards is going to rot.
fixes.right: The boards are going to rot.

drill.question: Lavabodaki su tam kenarda, musluk hâlâ açık. Ne dersin?
drill.optionB: The sink is going to overflow.
drill.explain: İşaretler görünüyor, birazdan olacak: is going to.

blocks.text: Biriyle sözleştiysen ve saat belliyse — «yarın altıda» — 9. dersteki biçim kullanılır: am / is / are + -ing ve zaman. I am meeting the carer tomorrow — «yarın bakıcıyla buluşuyorum». Zaman olmadan cümle «şu an» gibi duyulur.

examples.en: I am meeting the carer tomorrow.
We are meeting the babysitter at six tomorrow.
We are visiting a car boot sale on Sunday.
They are meeting at the book club tonight.

fixes.wrong: I am meet the carer tomorrow.
fixes.right: I am meeting the carer tomorrow.

blocks.text: going to — kendin karar verdin: I am going to renew my pass. Zamanla -ing — biriyle sözleştin, tarih belli: We are paying for our membership on Friday. İkisi de gelecekle ilgili; fark, bir anlaşma olup olmaması.

examples.en: I am going to renew my pass.
I am bringing my appointment card tomorrow.
I am going to attend a christening.
We are attending a hen party on Saturday.

drill.why: Anlaşma ve zaman var: am / is / are + -ing.

fixes.wrong: I going to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going to descaling the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

blocks.text: Türkçedeki tek «-ecek» eki İngilizcede dört parça: kim + am / is / are + going + to. Hiçbirini atlama.
Kendin karar verdin — am / is / are going to + eylem. Olacağı belli — yine going to. Sözleştin, zaman belli — am / is / are + -ing + ne zaman.

examples.en: We are going to apply an undercoat.
The scarf is going to unravel.
They are meeting the cleaner tomorrow morning.
